subject: Request: short-term onboarding credit exception for StellarBio
messages:
From: Ethan Zhao <ezhao@stellarbio.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@stellarbio.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick favor: extra onboarding credits for 30-day pilot?

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier this week — the Redwood runtime looks very promising for our NER-heavy pipeline. We spun up the 30-day pilot last week and have already consumed most of the allowance while running representative workloads (our token burn is higher than expected). We're scheduled to finish the final evaluation by the end of the month, but we're at risk of running out of credits mid-test.

Would Redwood be able to approve a one-off top-up of credits (approximately 50k token-equivalent) or a 7-day trial extension so we can complete the last set of tests? We want to validate latency across bursts and run the final integration tests across two models. If you can approve, happy to sign a short mutual action plan.

I've attached a compact onboarding plan and the test matrix so you can see how the tokens will be used. This is time-sensitive for our procurement cycle (they want a recommendation by next Wednesday).

Appreciate any help you can provide.

—Ethan
StellarBio — Senior ML Engineer
[Attachment: StellarBio-OnboardingPlan.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick favor: extra onboarding credits for 30-day pilot?

Forwarding Ethan's note — StellarBio is mid-pilot and requesting a one-off 50k token top-up or a short extension. They cite higher-than-expected burn from burst testing and need to finish by end of month. Procurement is on a tight cadence.

Questions for approvals:
- Approve single-use promo code for 50k token credit or 7-day trial extension?
- Any billing/contract caveats (procurement may want a short addendum)?
- If approved, who will send the code and update HubSpot + issuance log?

I don't want to block the evaluation window — marking as time-sensitive. Attaching their plan.

Thanks,
Naomi
Account Executive, PLG Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: StellarBio-OnboardingPlan.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick favor: extra onboarding credits for 30-day pilot?

Naomi — thanks for flagging.

Decision: approve a one-off, single-use credit issuance for StellarBio with the following conditions:
- 50,000 token-equivalent credit; single-use tied to account StellarBio (company id 67890).
- Valid for 30 days from issuance; no automatic renewal.
- Customer must confirm completion of the final test and provide a short post-pilot note; we'll request feedback on performance and unit economics.

I've generated an issuance and recorded it: code STELLAR-50K-20270521 (single-use). Ben — please send the code and activation instructions to Ethan and update HubSpot + the promo-issuance-log.csv. Jordan — FYI for CS readiness if they need help during the extended tests.

Cc'ing procurement guidance: if they request a contract addendum, send to legal; otherwise this is a one-off promotional credit and doesn't change existing terms.

Approve logged by: Marissa Cole (Sales Ops Lead)
[Attachment: promo-issuance-log.csv (csv)]
